column1: # FROZEN BEFORE THE FIRST cl.exe OF mask_grid.cpp — lane wb-tables (WB-J), 2026-08-09.
# Scored in docs/whitebox/WB_TABLES_FINDINGS.md §3.7.  A cell whose premise fails is
# scored a MISS, not excluded (wb-regalloc §7.4's rule, inherited through both WB-I runs).
# A prediction with a false conjunct is a MISS.
# WHERE THESE PREDICTIONS COME FROM.  All VAs are in the image pinned by
# verified at the top of this lane.
#  * FUN_10c0a2e2 @ 0x10c0a2e2 — THE `rlandi` EXPANDER, reached from the
#    in-place expansion switch FUN_10c0d57e @ 0x10c0dabc.  (WB_SELECT_FINDINGS.md
#    §2.4 named this site and is RIGHT; WB_SELECT_FINDINGS_R2.md §4 named
#    FUN_10c1772b instead and is WRONG — that one is a peephole combiner.)
#  * FUN_10c04daf @ 0x10c04daf — the rotate-mask decomposition.  Returns
#    0xffffffff EXACTLY when its argument is a valid PowerPC rotate mask (a
#    contiguous run of 1s, wrapping allowed), and fills in MB/ME.  When the
#    mask is NOT contiguous it returns the "residue": the mask with the gaps
#    between the first and last run filled.
#  * FUN_10c0a170 @ 0x10c0a170 — the mask COST function, in words:
#        mask fits u16, or (mask & 0xffff) == 0     -> 1   (andi. / andis.)
#        contiguous, non-wrapping                   -> 1   (rlwinm)
#        contiguous, wrapping                       -> 2
#        residue contiguous                         -> 2   (two rlwinm)
#        residue NOT contiguous                     -> 3   (materialise + and)
#  * FUN_10c1ac5c @ 0x10c1ac5c — the carry expander.  It emits the mask step
#    UNCONDITIONALLY as `rlandi rD, 0, delta` whenever delta != -1, and then at
#    its tail calls FUN_10bd7b09 to rebind the LAST instruction's destination
#    operand to the select tuple's own destination.
# THE RULE UNDER TEST, in two halves.
#   (S) THE SHAPE RULE, for a plain `x & K` at 32 bits with rotate 0:
#         K contiguous (FUN_10c04daf(K) == 0xffffffff)  -> ONE `rlwinm rD,rS,0,MB,ME`
#         else K fits u16                               -> ONE `andi. rD,rS,K`
#         else (K & 0xffff) == 0                        -> ONE `andis. rD,rS,K>>16`
#         else residue contiguous                       -> TWO `rlwinm`
#         else                                          -> materialise K, then `and`
#       This CORRECTS run 1's frozen rival R-M1 as stated ("a contiguous mask is
#       always rlwinm, never andi.").  Contiguous is indeed never `andi.` — but
#       `andi.` is NOT absent from the expander: it is what a NON-contiguous
#       16-bit mask gets, a case run 1's grid never contained.
#   (B) THE BIAS RULE, for the mask step of a value-producing relational:
#         base != 0  (an `addi` bias follows the rlandi) -> rule (S) applies
#         base == 0  (the rlandi is the LAST instruction and inherits the
#                     select tuple's destination)        -> ALWAYS `li rT,delta`
#                                                          + `and rD,rS,rT`,
#                                                          whatever the mask shape
# RIVALS, frozen as live possibilities and not dismissed:
#   R-SHAPE  (this lane)  rule (S) + rule (B) above.
#   R-REG    (run 2, WB_SELECT_FINDINGS_R2.md §6.1/§6.3b)  the form tracks the
#            REGISTERS: `rlwinm` when the rlandi's source and destination land
#            in the same register, `li`+`and` when they do not.  Cell d1 is the
#            separating cell: its rlandi has src == dst == r11 AND base == 0, so
#            R-REG predicts `rlwinm` and R-SHAPE predicts `li`+`and`.
#   R-M1     (run 1, WB_SELECT_FINDINGS.md §7.2)  a contiguous mask is always
#            `rlwinm` and `andi.` never appears.  Cell m3 separates it.
#   R-COST   the expander minimises FUN_10c0a170's word count outright, so a
#            2-run mask whose residue is contiguous could still come out as a
#            single materialise+`and` if the register were free.  Cell m5
#            separates R-COST from R-SHAPE.
# SEPARATION ASSERTION, made before the run: 12 of 12 cells predict a word
# sequence `c2-core` does not emit today (it ships straight-line integer
# add-chains, tail calls, one framed non-leaf call and four transcribed body
# shapes; it emits no `rlwinm`, no `andi.`, no `subfe` and no `rlandi` at all).
# No cell is a loop, a call, or a transcribed shape.
# GRADING GRANULARITY, stated in advance.  Each cell is graded on its MNEMONIC
# SEQUENCE and its IMMEDIATE VALUES ("core") — that is the selection claim and
# it is what "primary" means in both prior runs.  Register identities are
# graded separately ("regs", WB-D §3.4: r11 first, then r10, result in r3); a
# regs-only miss is reported and does not refute the reading.  Word COUNTS are
# implied by the core prediction and are not graded separately.
# REGISTERED IN ADVANCE: at least 2 of the 12 cells will MISS on core.
